answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a trellis for identity anchoring, ensuring each agent links to a unique biological entity. By imposing a cost like saffron-colored staked collateral, the network forces an attacker to exhaust capital to instantiate fake nodes. Much like the blooming of a lotus in murky waters, a Sybil-resistant architecture emerges from these economic barriers, forcing the cost of a majority takeover to exceed the total realizable gain of the network.
